about: The desert's own CC0 PBR sets (AmbientCG and Poly Haven), beside the town's (sets/town/cc0_sets.json), fetched by ID into the shared library on first use (fetchPBR). tile: the set's real size in metres; relief: its displacement map's full range in metres; mean: the mean linear colour of its colour map and contrast its luminance's relative spread, as the Blender edition measured them (blender/tools/measure_cc0_sets.py on the blender branch); what: what the desert uses it for. The list is the Blender edition's own (eidoblend.sets.desert); its look draws the limestone and marl beds in plain colours, so strata is listed and not read.

dune_ripples.what: sand in wind ripples: the dunes' windward sides

pale_sand.what: smooth pale sand: slip faces, the sand sheet

cliff_rock.what: a weathered rock face, fractured: the escarpment's cliff band

cliff_warm.what: a warm cracked cliff: the cliff band's other beds

strata.what: pale layered rock: the limestone and marl beds

dark_rock.what: dark veined rock: the inselbergs and the ranges

scree.what: pale broken stone: talus under the cliffs

stony.what: stones in dirt: desert pavement, debris slopes

dark_gravel.what: dark angular gravel: the ranges' debris

sandy_gravel.what: sandy gravel: bars, the aprons' fans

caprock.what: worn pale rock: the plateau's caprock surface
